FIELDS.NAME: Harmonic Dance & Arts Academy
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Harmonic Dance & Arts Academy, we specialize in providing high-quality instruction in dance, drama, and music for students of all ages. Our operations revolve around offering structured training programs across various artistic disciplines, ensuring that all instructors hold current, verifiable certifications relevant to their fields. We maintain a strong commitment to safety and compliance with local regulations, conducting regular safety audits and background checks for all staff, especially those working with minors. Our facilities are purpose-built for performance art, incorporating state-of-the-art equipment and safety features, including functional emergency exits and well-maintained common areas. We pride ourselves on fostering a positive learning environment, where students receive personalized attention through small class sizes and qualified instruction. Our curriculum remains dynamic, reflecting student feedback and industry best practices, further enhancing the educational experience we provide.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities that would restrict coverage, including operating with unqualified staff or failing to maintain proper documentation of instructor credentials. We confirm that all our instructors possess the necessary certifications for their roles, and we have a clean history with no unresolved claims regarding staff qualifications or facility safety. Furthermore, our facilities meet all minimum safety standards, including operational emergency exits, fire alarms, and well-maintained equipment.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Artistic Expressions Studio - A local community arts center offering workshops in visual arts and creative writing, ensuring a focus on arts education and community engagement.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No reported losses to date. All operations as of October 2023 have been incident-free, with proper safety measures and compliance protocols in place.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 8 PM; Saturday: 9 AM - 5 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Security trained staff conduct routine inspections; all cash and valuables stored in a secure safe with restricted access.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during class hours for student safety and vigilance against unauthorized access.
